marketing.metaTitle: Keduck AI - Chat-first AI creation and multi-platform publishing
marketing.metaDescription: A chat-centric AI content workspace: persona creation, trend expansion, multi-platform writing, smart visuals, and integrated publishing. Supports direct publishing in chat, manual publishing after document editing, and scheduled auto-run publishing plans.
marketing.jsonLdDescription: A chat-first AI creation platform for Toutiao, Xiaohongshu, WeChat Official Accounts, Zhihu, Baijiahao, and CSDN. Supports persona-driven writing, trend-based secondary creation, AI/web/library visuals, and both manual and automated publishing workflows.
marketing.metaFeaturesDescription: Learn how Keduck AI connects personas, topic expansion, writing, visuals, and publishing through chat, and enables automated execution with scheduled plans.
marketing.metaGuideTitle: User Guide - From chat to publish
marketing.metaGuideDescription: From persona creation and trend expansion to writing and publishing: supports both direct chat publishing and manual publishing after document editing, plus full-process scheduled automation.
marketing.metaPricingDescription: Three plan tiers with monthly and yearly billing. Final pricing is shown in the in-app "Buy Plan" page.
marketing.metaDownloadDescription: Download the Keduck AI desktop app for Windows, macOS Intel, and macOS Apple Silicon.
marketing.metaFaqDescription: Covers common questions about personas, topic expansion, chat publishing, manual publishing, scheduled automation, visual options, and platform support.
marketing.metaContactDescription: Business collaboration, channel partnerships, and technical support contacts.
marketing.metaTermsDescription: Keduck AI User Agreement covering account usage, platform integrations, billing, and liability boundaries.
marketing.metaPrivacyDescription: Keduck AI Privacy Policy covering information collection, usage, sharing, storage, and user rights.
marketing.downloadPanelSubtitle: Choose the build that matches your device
marketing.downloadPageSubtitle: Choose the build that matches your device and start creating and publishing quickly.
marketing.heroTitleHighlight: AI chat creation and publishing assistant
marketing.heroTitle: Publish high-quality content consistently with chat
marketing.heroSubtitle: Complete the full creation flow in chat: persona, trend expansion, drafting, and publishing. Supports direct chat publishing, manual publishing after document editing, and scheduled automation.
marketing.spotlightsSubtitle: Built for faster output with higher consistency: chat creation at the core, personas and trends for quality, smart visuals and publishing for execution.
marketing.spotlightChatDesc: The core capability: complete persona setup, topic expansion, drafting, rewriting, and publish decisions in one continuous chat.
marketing.spotlightPersonaDesc: Describe tone, audience, and guardrails in chat so every draft sounds like the same brand voice.
marketing.spotlightTopicsDesc: Drop a trend or keyword and iterate angles, outlines, and examples—still in conversation.
marketing.spotlightImageDesc: Use AI image generation, web image search, or your asset library, then let the system place suitable visuals into the draft automatically.
marketing.spotlightPublishDesc: Publish in two ways: send by chat command to target accounts, or edit in-document and publish manually.
marketing.spotlightAutomationDesc: Set task name, prompt, publishing accounts, and schedule notes, then let the system create and publish automatically on cadence.
marketing.audienceTitle: Who is it for? Teams and individuals needing stable content output
marketing.audienceSubtitle: Whether you work in content, growth, or operations, Keduck AI helps you create and publish more reliably.
marketing.audience1Desc: Quickly produce external viewpoints, announcement interpretations, and industry commentary with consistent tone and high publishing efficiency.
marketing.audience2Desc: Produce content in batches around trends, keep persona style unified, and significantly improve output capacity.
marketing.audience3Desc: Run content experiments based on user feedback and market trends to support product iteration and growth strategy.
marketing.audience4Desc: Turn scattered ideas into repeatable columns and publish steadily to grow your personal brand.
marketing.choosePoint1Title: Fast to start, steady to run
marketing.choosePoint1Desc: Start from chat and move through a clear workflow from idea to publishing, with smoother team collaboration.
marketing.choosePoint2Desc: Supports manual confirmation and scheduled automation for better control over publishing cadence, with centralized management of key data and assets.
marketing.testimonialsSubtitle: Feedback from real operators and creators
marketing.testimonial1Quote: Our team used to lose hours on topic picking and rewrites. Now we expand trends in chat and draft with personas in one flow.
marketing.testimonial2Quote: Execution is the key. Once scheduled plans are configured, the system runs creation and publishing on time with minimal supervision.
marketing.testimonial3Quote: The visual workflow is a big win. AI images, web search, and library assets all work together, and insertion is automatic.
marketing.featuresSubtitle: Bring key creation and publishing actions into one unified workflow: if it can be done in chat, you don't need to keep switching pages.
marketing.featuresPageLead: The full workflow is: personas support creation, trends drive topic selection, chat generates content, smart visuals enrich drafts, and publishing executes delivery. Chat publishing supports both "continue chatting and issue publish commands after generation" and "open the document for edits, then publish manually". For stable batch execution, fill in task name, prompt, publish accounts, and schedule details in "Create Scheduled Plan" so the system can create and publish automatically on schedule.
marketing.feature1Desc: In one continuous chat, complete persona setup, topic expansion, writing, and revision without jumping between multiple modules.
marketing.feature2Title: Personas make content sound like you
marketing.feature2Desc: After creating personas, AI consistently follows your tone, audience, and expression style for more coherent and recognizable output.
marketing.feature3Desc: Perform secondary creation based on platform trends: expand directions first, then get executable topic suggestions to enter writing mode faster.
marketing.feature4Desc: Supports AI image generation, web image search, and media library images. The system matches visuals based on your choice and inserts them automatically into the article.
marketing.feature5Desc: You can publish directly to target accounts in chat, or enter the document editor for refinement and publish manually to each platform.
marketing.feature6Desc: After filling plan information, the system automatically runs the full AI creation workflow and publishing at scheduled times, ideal for continuous operations and batch tasks.
marketing.guideSubtitle: First complete "persona - expansion - writing" in chat, then choose chat publishing, manual document publishing, or scheduled auto-publishing based on your scenario.
marketing.guidePageLead: You can start from any step, but we recommend defining personas and topic logic first before publishing for more stable quality and efficiency.
marketing.guideStep1Title: Sign in and open Creation Center
marketing.guideStep1Desc: Open Creation Center from the sidebar and start a new chat. Clearly describe your goal, platform, and tone requirements in one go.
marketing.guideStep2Title: Complete personas and topic selection in chat
marketing.guideStep2Desc: First create creation-focused personas (tone, audience, expression boundaries), then expand ideas based on platform trends to get a batch of directly writable topic suggestions.
marketing.guideStep3Desc: Specify target platform, length, and structure to generate content. For visuals, choose AI generation, web search, or media library; the system inserts suitable images automatically.
marketing.guideStep4Desc: Method 1: keep chatting after generation and tell AI which account to publish to directly. Method 2: open the document for edits first, then publish manually to each platform. For scheduled automation, fill in "Create Scheduled Plan" and let the system create and publish on time automatically.
marketing.guideStep5Desc: Store reusable assets and finalized drafts in the library to make team sharing and review easier.
marketing.guideStep6Desc: Open "Buy Plan" from the personal menu, then choose monthly or yearly billing and complete payment.
marketing.pricingSubtitle: Three tiers aligned with in-app plans. Feature overview below; live prices are shown inside the app.
marketing.pricingPageLead: Credits power chat creation and scheduled-plan automation (including cadence-based generation and publish steps). Final amounts are shown in-app.
marketing.pricingFootnote: Prices and promotions may change; see the in-app purchase dialog for current amounts and invoices.
marketing.faqPageLead: Common questions about personas, trend expansion, chat publishing, manual publishing, automation plans, and platform support.
marketing.faq1Q: Do I need to log in before using it?
marketing.faq1A: Core creation and publishing features require login. You can browse the website first, then register or log in inside the app.
marketing.faq2A: Steps such as chat generation, visual generation, tool calls, and scheduled-plan execution consume credits according to rules. Refer to in-app details for specifics.
marketing.faq3A: Currently supports content formats and structures for Toutiao, Xiaohongshu, WeChat Official Accounts, Zhihu, Baijiahao, and CSDN. Exact capabilities and account binding rules are shown in-app.
marketing.faq4A: Use official downloads and channels. Follow your org’s compliance policies and back up important assets and finals.
marketing.faq5Q: What publishing options are available, and how should I choose?
marketing.faq5A: There are three options: 1) Chat publishing: continue chatting after generation and issue commands to publish to target accounts. 2) Manual publishing: edit in document mode first, then manually choose platform and account. 3) Auto-publishing: fill in a scheduled plan and the system creates and publishes automatically on schedule. Use chat publishing for temporary trends, manual publishing for polished drafts, and auto-publishing for stable recurring columns.
